result.document_summary: Part 2 of 2 of Hoboken, NJ Code Chapter 155 (rent control/Rent Leveling and Stabilization), covering enforcement, maintenance standards, the rent cap, compliance certificates, registration, vacancy decontrol, condo/co-op initial rental decontrol, and a COVID-19 rent-increase moratorium.
result.notes: Extracted a single rent_increase_limits record for the Hoboken rent control ordinance (Chapter 155), since rules in the same category and instrument are merged; the vacancy decontrol 25% cap, certificate-of-compliance requirement, and condo/co-op decontrol are details of that instrument. The earlier part of the chapter (not in this part) presumably holds the CPI formula (§ 155-5), definitions, and coverage/exemptions, so coverage is left empty here and no effective date is stated in this part. The COVID-19 moratorium (April 1, 2020 to May 7, 2022) has expired and is not separately recorded. Violations, enforcement, appeals, and registration fee provisions are procedural and not in scope.

rules.title: Hoboken rent control: base rent ceiling, vacancy decontrol cap, and compliance certificate requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords may not charge rent above the amounts permitted under Chapter 155, and a regular increase notice must include a certificate of substantial compliance with housing, building, fire and property maintenance codes or the notice is invalid. When a registered unit is voluntarily vacated, the next tenant's initial rent is limited to 25% over the last rent paid, after which the unit is again subject to the chapter.
rules.key_value: Vacancy decontrol: initial rent capped at 25% over prior tenant's rent; no unit decontrolled more than once in 3 years
rules.quoted_span: said rental shall be limited to an increase of 25% over the last rental paid by the tenant who voluntarily vacated the rental unit, exclusive of any capital improvement surcharge that is a component of said last rental.
rules.coverage_text: Dwelling units subject to Hoboken's Chapter 155 rent control ordinance; the coverage tests (such as unit counts or exemptions) are in the earlier part of the chapter and are not stated in this part.
rules.exemptions_text: This part contains no general coverage exemptions; it only provides vacancy decontrol for registered units on voluntary vacancy or legal eviction, and a one-time initial-rent decontrol when a bona fide condo/co-op owner-occupant of two years vacates and rents the unit.
rules.interaction: The unit remains subject to Chapter 155 after the initial decontrolled rental, and failure to register annually can result in denial of CPI and vacancy decontrol increases.
